$comment: Tests that cannot pass as-is. Every entry must say WHY in 'kind' terms:
kind=environment  -> the test needs a host capability this runner does not have;
the gate re-checks the probe at runtime and only skips when the
capability is really missing, so a normal dev machine still runs it.
kind=fixture      -> a real red test kept honest by an owner and a review date.
Remove an entry as soon as the underlying cause is fixed; the gate fails on stale entries.

entries.reason: The production launcher verifies process-group leadership with /bin/ps. Restricted runners reject it, so the child reports 'phi-run: /bin/ps: Operation not permitted' plus PHI_LAUNCH:NOT_GROUP_LEADER before any assertion runs.
Same production launcher dependency on /bin/ps: 'Composition CLI failed: phi-run: /bin/ps: Operation not permitted'.
Same production launcher dependency on /bin/ps. Also the slowest suite (tens of real child processes), so it belongs to the slow tier even on a capable host.
